<!-- SECTION 04 — THE KLEZA OUTSOURCING MODEL -->
<section class="es-sec oo-model" data-screen-label="Outsourcing Model">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="es-head">
      <div class="left">
        <span class="eyebrow">The Model</span>
        <h2 class="es-h2">How our outsourcing <span class="ital">model works.</span></h2>
      </div>
      <p class="es-lede">Not a shared resource pool. Dedicated people, trained for your operational reality, working under signed compliance agreements.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="oo-model-grid">
      <div class="oo-model-col">
        <span class="num">01</span>
        <div class="hr"></div>
        <h3>Dedicated Teams, Not Shared Resources</h3>
        <p>Your outsourced team members work exclusively for your organisation during agreed hours. They learn your systems, your culture, and your way of working. You are not buying slots in a shared pool &mdash; you are gaining dedicated people.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="oo-model-col">
        <span class="num">02</span>
        <div class="hr"></div>
        <h3>Domain Training Before Day One</h3>
        <p>Every team member Kleza places is trained on your industry&rsquo;s operational context before they start. For healthcare clients, that means US home care scheduling norms, HIPAA awareness, caregiver communication standards, and your specific software systems.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="oo-model-col">
        <span class="num">03</span>
        <div class="hr"></div>
        <h3>Compliance Assurance Built In</h3>
        <p>Kleza maintains signed confidentiality and data handling agreements for all outsourcing engagements. For healthcare clients, all team members handling client or patient-adjacent data operate under HIPAA-compliant protocols.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- SECTION 07 — CASE STUDY -->
<section class="es-sec" data-screen-label="Case Study">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="es-head"><div class="left" style="max-width:840px"><span class="eyebrow">Case Study</span><h2 class="es-h2" style="margin-top:14px;font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,44px)">Scaling a home care agency&rsquo;s scheduling operation <span class="ital">&mdash; without a single additional US hire.</span></h2></div></div>
    <div class="oo-case">
      <div class="oo-case-metric">
        <div class="inner">
          <div class="stat">98%</div>
          <div class="stat-lab">Shift coverage rate post-deployment, up from 87% prior.</div>
          <div class="client">
            <div class="k">Client</div>
            <div class="v">Regional home care agency &middot; United States</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="oo-case-body">
        <div class="oo-case-row"><div class="lab">Challenge</div><p>A fast-growing home care agency was struggling with scheduling coverage as client volume grew <b>40%</b> in 12 months. Internal coordinators were consistently overloaded, leading to missed shifts and caregiver churn.</p></div>
        <div class="oo-case-row"><div class="lab">Approach</div><p>Kleza deployed two dedicated scheduling coordinators, trained on the agency&rsquo;s scheduling software and caregiver roster, both operating during US business hours.</p></div>
        <div class="oo-case-row"><div class="lab">Outcome</div><p>Shift coverage improved from <b>87% to 98%</b> within 60 days and internal coordinator overtime fell by <b>60%</b> &mdash; the agency continued scaling without adding US-based administrative headcount.</p></div>
        <div class="oo-case-note">Illustrative engagement &mdash; metrics to be verified against approved client data before publishing.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="es-sec" style="padding-top:0" data-screen-label="FAQ">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="es-head" style="justify-content:center;text-align:center;flex-direction:column;align-items:center"><span class="eyebrow">FAQ</span><h2 class="es-h2" style="margin-top:14px">Frequently asked <span class="ital">questions.</span></h2></div>
    <div class="es-faq">
      <div class="es-faq-item"><button class="es-faq-q">What types of roles can Kleza outsource for my organisation?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="es-faq-a"><p>Kleza covers four operational categories: US accounting and finance, HR and talent acquisition, scheduling and care coordination, and administrative and back-office support. All roles are staffed with trained, dedicated team members &mdash; not shared resources.</p></div></div>
      <div class="es-faq-item"><button class="es-faq-q">How is confidential data handled by the outsourced team?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="es-faq-a"><p>All Kleza outsourcing engagements include signed confidentiality and data processing agreements. Team members handling client, patient, or financial data operate under HIPAA-compliant protocols for healthcare clients, and under agreed data handling standards for all clients.</p></div></div>
      <div class="es-faq-item"><button class="es-faq-q">How quickly can an outsourced team become operational?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="es-faq-a"><p>Most engagements reach full operational readiness within 15-21 days of contract signing &mdash; covering scoping, team selection, and domain training. The exact timeline depends on role complexity and the depth of your system and process onboarding requirements.</p></div></div>
      <div class="es-faq-item"><button class="es-faq-q">Is the outsourced team dedicated to my organisation?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="es-faq-a"><p>Yes. Kleza does not operate a shared resource pool. Your team members work exclusively for your organisation during agreed hours &mdash; learning your systems, your culture, and your operational standards.</p></div></div>
      <div class="es-faq-item"><button class="es-faq-q">Can I scale the outsourced team up or down over time?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="es-faq-a"><p>Yes. Kleza&rsquo;s outsourcing engagements are designed to flex with your operational needs. Team size can be scaled up with 2 weeks notice and scaled down with 30 days notice, without long-term headcount commitments.</p></div></div>
